symptom_heard: A 'boxy' or 'muffled' sound where the melody gets buried by the chords.
root_cause: Excessive filtering on mid-range elements masking the lead melody.
avoid_rule: Do not apply aggressive low-pass filtering to both chords and bass simultaneously; ensure at least one melodic element remains in the high-mid frequency spectrum.

symptom_heard: Piercing, unnatural metallic chirping in the high frequency spectrum.
root_cause: Applying an extreme high-pass filter (6kHz+) to standard hi-hat samples, removing all body and leaving only aliased artifacts.
avoid_rule: Never high-pass percussion above 3kHz unless attempting a specific 'telephone' or 'lo-fi radio' effect.

symptom_heard: Low-end rumble and loss of definition in the bassline when the kick hits.
root_cause: Uncontrolled frequency collision between the fundamental frequencies of the kick and the sub-bass.
avoid_rule: Always use sidechain compression or EQ cutting on melodic bass elements when using a heavy kick.

symptom_heard: Rhythm section sounds distant and lacks percussive impact.
root_cause: Improper gain staging and lack of dynamic processing (sidechaining) causing the bass to mask the kick.
avoid_rule: Never allow the kick drum and bass to occupy the same frequency space without sidechain compression or EQ carving.

symptom_heard: Muddy low-end and digital distortion at the downbeat
root_cause: Unchecked frequency masking between the sub-bass and the kick drum
avoid_rule: Always apply sidechain ducking or subtractive EQ to the bass when using a prominent kick drum.
